title: Carbene transfer from thianthrenium ylides for cyclopropanation
description:
Nature, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11108-z

Thianthrenium ylides can be used as a general platform for metal–carbene generation and transfer, including cyclopropanation, σ-bond insertion and sigmatropic rearrangements.
